source.title: Inscription: Unable to mill Arathor's Spear
source.author: Jonar
source.quote: I had 119 in my reagent bag but it didn’t show up as being able to be milled.

quote: I had 119 in my reagent bag but it didn’t show up as being able to be milled.
notes: INDEPENDENT FIRSTHAND ELIGIBILITY CONFLICT: 2024 player reports Arathor's Spear absent from the Khaz Algar Milling selection even with enough herbs. Method's TWW milling guide lists only four millable herb families and omits Arathor's Spear; a separate French Inscription guide explicitly excludes it. Existing source-only recipe rows war-within-20261110-0733-009/010/011 mapped Arathor's Spear ranks 1/2/3 (210808/210809/210810) to generic spell 444181 solely from the generic spell text; these associations lack process-specific support and should be held for Master correction. This is not proof of current 2026 live-client eligibility, and no mill operations, yields or rates are inferred. A noMill schema/eligibility action needs Master approval.
lookingFor: Verify that Arathor's Spear ranks 1/2/3 (210808/210809/210810) are valid input ingredients for Khaz Algar Milling spell 444181; seek firsthand game UI, recipe whitelist and material outputs.
